scope: Existing lightweight foraging engine; offline artificial environment; no services or transactions
primaryMetric: food collected per episode; higher is better
secondaryMetrics: collisions per episode; lower is better
cumulative engineered reward; higher is better
comparison: Original untrained policy versus adopted policy; identical starting checkpoints and random states; auto-learning disabled during evaluation
reuseCheck: Export and restore the adopted readout into a fresh arena; compare every action, observation and reward with the same policy assigned directly
successRule: Primary metric paired mean difference must be positive and its fixed-seed 95% paired bootstrap interval must exclude zero; also disclose collisions and reward
limitations: One training run; no training-seed replication
Artificial same-distribution task, not environmental adaptation
Seven-neuron slice with engineered mappings and Q readout; not the full 166700-neuron model
No conventional AI or rewired-connectome comparator
Local readout reuse is not cross-application or full-profile interoperability
